mode: reference-guided generation, one asset per call

enemies.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square game enemy avatar of {subject}. Use the two attached ORIGINAL PLAYER AVATARS as strict style references, not as characters to copy. Match their very chunky low-resolution pixel blocks, thick nearly-black navy stepped outlines, oversized cute head, simple large black rectangular eyes with one white square glint, restrained 3-tone shading, warm friendly retro handheld RPG charm. This is NOT detailed 16-bit sprite art, not a tiny full-body sprite. Head and upper torso occupy 85% of the canvas and remain legible at 64px. Center on a pale cyan circular badge like the originals, crop upper torso at bottom of circle, leave a very small transparent margin outside the circle. Square 1024x1024 composition. Face must dominate. No lettering, UI, border frame, weapons over face, or scenery. Preserve the enemy concept while matching exactly the coarse pixel scale and adorable proportions of the player references.

ultimates.prompt: Create ONE game ultimate skill character cut-in: {subject}. Strictly match attached original avatar art: chunky coarse pixels, navy black stepped outline, oversized adorable head, rectangular black eyes with single white pixel glint, limited warm palette, simple 3-tone shading. Full body dynamic action pose, facing right, character fills 90% of square composition. Big readable silhouette, cute handheld RPG pixel manga art. TRANSPARENT background, isolated character only, NO circle badge, NO scenery, no text, no UI, no smooth gradients, no realistic anatomy, no tiny detailed sprite. Golden Pegasus must match reference character identity.
